# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# v38.0 Overlord-aware CoA triggers for dynamic colonial ensigns (main_menu/common/flag_definitions/oe_col4_flag_definitions.txt).

oe_col4_coa_overseas_colony_trigger = {
	coa_def_rebel_trigger = no
	coa_def_pirates_trigger = no
	exists = scope:overlord
	scope:actor ?= {
		scope_type = country
		OR = {
			is_subject_type = colonial_nation
			is_subject_type = trade_company
			is_subject_type = conquistador
			AND = {
				is_subject = yes
				OR = {
					is_subject_type = vassal
					is_subject_type = dominion
					is_subject_type = fiefdom
				}
				capital ?= {
					OR = {
						continent = continent:america
						continent = continent:oceania
					}
				}
				scope:overlord = {
					capital ?= {
						NOR = {
							continent = continent:america
							continent = continent:oceania
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
